messages.text: Hello. Salma Nasser said I should ask you about the masquerade. Is it really open to anyone?
Anyone with a ticket! It's for the children's ward. Costumes required.
I have a costume. I've never been to a party like this. A human one, I mean. A big one.
Haha you'll love it. See you there.
Can we talk about the photos? Not here.
Please don't post any of them.
You're missing from every photo Ziad took. Did you edit yourself out?
Delete them before anyone sees. I can't explain it.
I won't share them. I just want to know if the files were altered.
I did not change them. Please keep this between us.
